scope: Read-only PhaseB capture-wrapper/launch ordering and measurement-boundary review; no physics launch, runtime edits or new solver evaluation by reviewer.

checks.name: same original native driver
checks.reason: Unchanged I58 module and native m100_B run; copied historical registration is kept distinct from outerI69 protocol.

checks.name: correct run/step wrapper nesting
checks.reason: Patch sim.run=observed_run first. Collector captures that run as its delegate, then wraps native step/run. Outer observed_step sets context before collector.step. Every collector run1 invokes observed_run once, updating substep1..5 before original integration.

checks.name: inactive setup/reset context
checks.reason: Native reset/setup calls outside physical.step disable probe context. Full-history rawcollector includes native held intervals without extra observer, command, mirror, reset or control loop calls.

checks.name: fixed interval indexing
checks.reason: end_index=round(control_start/dt)+1. Frozen targets1575,6422,7011,7041 are observer endpoints7.875,32.110,35.055,35.205; each previous held interval is observed, not a later hold.

checks.name: cross-thread context visibility
checks.reason: Probe context uses global atomic enabled/time/substep fields. Python blocking run calls finish before the next context update. No thread-local context mismatch apparent.

checks.name: measurement boundary
checks.reason: Hooks delegate installed functions with original arguments, copy pre/post arrays and inspect after-delegate contact data. No solver arguments or native controller commands are changed; empirical capture parity remains required.

checks.name: LD_PRELOAD child boundary
checks.reason: Launcher clears inherited preload/all-capture flags and injects the private probe/path only through env within the fresh micromamba child. Parent runtime and installed binaries remain unmodified.

checks.name: failure/cleanup path
checks.reason: Context disabled in finally. Full raw trace/counters exported after active hold cleared, while wrapper stack still exists; exceptions retain failure receipt and partial trace. Final successful comparisons require exact59field set and unchanged source/input/binary hashes.

checks.name: full old trace comparison
checks.reason: Every original I68 trace key is compared by dtype/shape/bytes; metadata is separately allowed to differ. No numeric array differences are accepted. The collector itself is the unchanged I68 source.

qualifications: The standalone3call contract demonstrates solve interception/delegation, not empirical correctness of private ContactConstraint member offsets. Captured lambda/basis/dt must independently reconstruct contact.force.
Pointer-derived fallback offset/last-solver metadata must be validated using packet order and buffer flag; do not assume parent_solver_id always identifies the primary buffer.

If concurrent independent constraint groups appear, global last/primary solver association may be ambiguous; this wheel run is expected to contain one reactive assembly, but captured association must be checked rather than presumed.

Post-capture review should require59whole-history precision fields byte-exact, all old numeric substep arrays identical,20target1ms clocks present, complete packet decoding, force/point/normal matching and dimension-aware tangent reconstruction.
No conclusion about force-bound failure in the actual scene follows until installed-method packets are captured and validated.
decision: No material wrapper/launcher blocker found. Root may proceed under the already authorized frozen PhaseB protocol; this receipt does not substitute for required post-capture parity and association checks.
